title: Uka Milagro de Prueba Silenciosa
intro: Jumax mä figura envuelto sarnaqäwimpiw jikista, ukax divina intervención ukankiwa. Mä milagro churañ tuqit mä sarnaqäwi ukat jan arsuñjam arxatäwi, ukax tiempon ist’asi. ¿Khitinakas uka jan uñtʼat yantʼar puripjjäna uk amuytʼasmati?
clues: Diosan mä yatiyäwip katoqayäta, ukajj wal muspharayitäna
Mä wawamp kutt’ankta ukhax markajax q’uma kankañajat jiskt’asipxäna
Mä jukʼa tiempo jan parlañajatakiw ayunañajatak kamachitäna
Mä uma phuchʼu ukat dátiles ukanakaw juchañchatäkayäta ukhajj chʼamañchtʼitäna
Tatitux mä milagro quqaw ch’allxtayäna, nayatakix kunatix wakiski ukanak churañataki
Mä angelaw uñstawayitu mä jan juchani jaqir uñtata

outcome.answer: Kunapachatï jiskʼa wawajajj arskäna ukhaw jan juchanïtaj uñachtʼayasïna

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
